core_question: How are they doing — mood, rest and wellbeing trend over time, against their own baseline?

primary_entity_types.description: A coarse mood observation drawn from journals or role-filtered message emotions.
A component wellbeing score for a window, expressed as a band.
A rest or sleep span reduced to duration and quality bands.
A recurring wellbeing theme surfaced from owner journal entries.

extraction_hints: Describe mood and wellbeing as trends and bands against the owner's own baseline. Never quote journal text, never name or infer a medical condition, diagnosis, medication or treatment, and never emit a raw physiological value. This dimension is owner-sensitive: prefer abstaining over a low-confidence reading.
